Always Something New Washing Ashore

The Raft carries a regularly rotating selection of rare & unique, and nostalgic beverages, candy, and snacks. Nostalgic favorites you haven't seen since you were a kid, small-batch surprises, imports from around the world, and the strange stuff Stash drags in just to see the look on your face. If you spot something curious — grab it. It may float away before your next visit.

Craft Sodas

The Chippewa Valley's largest craft soda selection — 100+ bottled sodas at any given time, and always rotating. Proper cane-sugar root beers, regional bottlers, international imports, small batches, and flavors that shouldn't work but somehow do. Sip while you play, or take a treasure home.

Dirty Sodas

  • 1 'Pocket Flavors' syrup packet
  • 1 Handful of coconut creamers

  • 2 Craft sodas of your choice

Grab a cup, mix to your heart's desire, enjoy, and share!

Strange Snacks

International chips, puffy snacks, Pocky in flavors you didn't know existed, and Stash's own hand-packed snack mixes — fuel for long campaigns and longer game nights. The lineup rotates as fast as the river runs, so the strange snack you loved last month might already be a legend.

Did you know?
raft/raft/  noun
  1. A group of otters floating together — paws linked, bellies up, so nobody drifts away.
  2. The only proper way to enjoy a Float.

"A raft is how otters float."

We otters are the curious ones of the animal kingdom — we have to taste everything, and we always try the strange-looking one first. So when we rest, we don't head for shore. We float. We link paws so nobody drifts off, tip our bellies to the sun, and balance whatever curious treat we've found right there on our tummies. A whole bunch of us floating together even has a name: a raft. The best afternoons of my pup-hood were spent exactly like that — drifting easy, something cold and curious always within reach.

— Stash

Enjoy It All on The Deck

Every bottle, float, and snack from The Raft pairs perfectly with our multi-level lounge deck overlooking the Chippewa River — one of the best views in the city, no dice required. Grab a float and join the raft.
